description: Strict single-pass continuation overlay for the frozen Sentaurus 2022 TransportModels DD/DG baseline. Each curve is solved by one process, one immutable configuration and only the last accepted state; no external restart, historical same-bias seed or pointwise reclosure is allowed.

idvd_initialization.description: DD retains its verified direct Vg=1 V equilibrium. DG starts from its verified Vg=-1 V cold equilibrium and, in the same process, monotonically ramps the gate to Vg=1 V before the drain sweep. Each branch uses only its immediately preceding accepted state.
